summary: Build HR dashboards, analyze workforce data, and improve decisions with practical people analytics training. Enrol today.
lede: HR people analytics uses workforce data to inform talent, retention, and workforce-planning decisions. This course is for HR professionals who need to turn employee data into useful reports and action plans. You’ll practice checking data quality, calculating and interpreting metrics such as turnover and time-to-fill, and building dashboards with evidence-based recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR professionals who need to turn workforce data into decisions, reports, and action plans.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of HR processes, basic comfort with spreadsheets, and familiarity with core workforce data such as headcount, turnover, recruitment, and performance records. No programming is required, and advanced statistics are not assumed. If you already use Excel for HR reporting, that will help you move faster; if you manage HRIS or HR reporting workflows, bring examples of the metrics and dashboards you currently use. Before attending, you may prepare a sample HR report, a current dashboard, or a small anonymized workforce data extract, subject to your organization’s data handling rules. The course uses spreadsheet-based analysis and dashboard-oriented exercises, with conceptual exposure to predictive analytics and data governance rather than technical engineering depth.
